title: Intelligence Tactics Instructor (II/III) (LtCol to 2ndLt) and (CWO5 to WO) NMOS (0202, 0205, 0210, 2602), DIR INTEL
raw_text:
9. MOS 0233, Intelligence Tactics Instructor (II/III) (LtCol to 2ndLt) and
(CWO5 to WO) NMOS (0202, 0205, 0210, 2602), DIR INTEL

    a. Summary. The Intelligence Tactics Instructor (ITI) is well versed in
a variety of GCE intelligence-focused knowledge; critical thinking, decision
making skills and competencies, including planning, operating, and adversary
assessments in a dynamic environment, unit readiness planning, C2, GCE
intelligence section and tactical collection management, exposed to Adult &
Experiential Learning methods, and information management. Additionally, the
ITI community is expected to focus on intelligence training management and
the development of a mid-to-long range training plan for an intelligence
section.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Must possess PMOS 0202, 0205, 0210, or 2602.

        (2) Security requirement: must have a current single scope
background investigation/T5 investigation and adjudicated for sensitive
compartmented information (SCI) eligibility.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Must successfully complete the Intelligence and Tactics
Instructor Officer Course (M09CUR5) at MCTOG.

        (2) According to reference (cx), Marine Corps Ground Combat Element
Operations and Tactics Training Program, 02XX intelligence officers assigned
as GCE intelligence officers will be required to attend. All other MOS may
attend on a space available basis and receive the 0233 NMOS.

       d.   Duties

        (1) NMOS 0233 will be assigned to duties as Intelligence Officers
within the GCE to include Infantry Battalions, Recon Battalions, Light
Armored Recon Battalions, Infantry Regiments, and Artillery Regiments.

        (2) NMOS 0233s will serve as the unit’s SME for intelligence support
to mission planning, operations and intelligence integration, briefing/
debriefing, intelligence analysis, intelligence preparation of the
battlespace, intelligence related targeting tasks, network engagement, and
collection requirements management.




                                          1-15                   Enclosure (1)
 1105                                                                NAVMC 1200.1L



        (3) Build both unit and individual intelligence training plans for
intelligence and non-intelligence personnel.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Teachers and Instructors, All Other 25-3099.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
